Choosing the best dog food for your furry friend is always an easy task at PetSmart. PetSmart carries top-rated brands that you can trust and that your special pup will love. With a wide selection of flavors and textures you can be sure that your dog will be happy with what’s in their bowl and in their tummy. Shop for dog food by dog breed, age or size. No matter the preference of your pup, you’re sure to find a great fit at PetSmart.
PetSmart has the widest selection of the best dog food including delicious options like:
Dry Dog Food
Canned Dog Food 
Food Toppers
Fresh Dog Food
Frozen Dog Food
Milk Replacers
Puppy Food 
Vet-Authorized Diets
And More
You can find what you’re looking for to help your pets with living a happy and healthy life. Need other dog supplies while you’re here? We have you covered.
PetSmart also offers convenient shopping with curbside or in-store pickup. Need something today? We have select items available for same-day delivery in most areas powered by DoorDash. For items you purchase frequently, PetSmart has Autoship that automatically delivers the items you want to your door as often as you’d like. Check the website to see what items are eligible.
